research_requirements: Store hypothesis ID/version, creation time UTC, exact series/feed, units, formula/window/threshold, decision cutoff, horizon, outcome definition and invalidation/missing-data rule BEFORE the outcome period.

Store observation_date, provider_published_at_utc (nullable), first_seen_at_utc, retrieved_at_utc, vintage/as_of, value, source file hash, final/provisional flag, source timezone and current contract IDs.
Join signals by availability time at or before decision cutoff, not shared calendar date. Unknown release times cannot be silently backfilled as midnight.
Freeze the research sample, currency basis, corporate-action/roll settings and methodology regime. A changed symbol/provider is a new version, not a silent splice.
Keep snapshots unchanged; append corrections with new vintage. Use subsequent outcomes and predeclared horizons; report all hypotheses and missing outcomes, not only winners.
This package prepares metadata and evidence. It does not establish a complete point-in-time research database or create/test signal rules.
